title: Compact model tile collage and onboarding callouts for pricing & deprecation release
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact set of model catalog screenshots and onboarding callouts to include in the February release notes and quickstart docs. Focus on two main flows: (1) compact tile collage showing new model entries with inline pricing callouts and variant badges, (2) deprecation/beta state visuals for models being sunset or moved to legacy pricing. Assets should be optimized for doc embeds (1200x675), console release banners (1600x400), and in-console compact tiles (360x200).
deliverables: 3 export-ready screenshot packs: docs (1200x675), banner (1600x400), compact-card (360x200)
SVG badge set for status: new, recommended, beta, deprecated, legacy-pricing
Annotated Figma file with copy variants and accessibility notes
Light + dark theme mockups and an alternate high-contrast export
design_decisions: We standardize on a compact tile layout (left thumbnail, right stacked meta) to maximize legibility in tight placements. Pricing callouts use a two-line microcopy with emphasized per-token and per-1k unit lines so product writers can swap values without re-exporting art. Deprecation treatment uses a subtle diagonal ribbon plus accessible color tokens and a tooltip chevron for details. Avoided large hero images to keep docs load fast.
